notes: Where a vendor or a reputation's quartermaster stands, and what a vendor charges when it is not gold, so a BiS source line says what a player has to do (feedback 2026-11-09). Keys: vendors by npc id (loot.json's vendor:<npc_id> source), reputations by client faction id (a rep source's faction_id). A vendor's cost_by_slot prices its stock by the item's gear slot; a slot with no price stays unpriced, never guessed. data/pipeline/loot/vendor_terms.py writes place and item_costs into loot.json.

vendors.name: Pix Xizzix
vendors.why: Pix Xizzix sells for Tarnished Undermine Reals (currency 3469). The prices by slot are the beta vendor records on zockify.com and questing.wiki read on 2026-10-09 (content-phases.json gate undermine-reals). Relic prices were not recorded, so relics stay unpriced.
